summary: Example group_vars/dellos10.yml with network_cli, dellemc.os10.os10, vaulted passwords, become enable and optional proxy command.
questions: What group_vars do I need for Dell OS10?

answer_card.title: Dell OS10 group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: dellemc.os10.os10
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_become: true
ansible_become_method: enable
ansible_become_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
Drop `ansible_password` with SSH keys and the proxy line for direct access.
